title: Planning Committee: Agenda and Minutes
key_sentences: The meeting was held on Tuesday 9 June 2026 at 7.00 pm in the Village Hall, Elm Lane.
The chair, Councillor Abernathy, opened the meeting and welcomed the three members of the public present.
The committee considered the following applications and agreed the comments shown.
The chair thanked the members of the public for their contributions and closed the meeting at 8.25 pm.
These minutes are a draft until they are approved at the next meeting.

rows: Minutes of the meeting held on 12 May
Send planning comments to the district council and copy them to the applicants
Draft the response to the footpath consultation and circulate it for comment
Ask the highways department about the parking survey on Church Street
Publish the minutes on the council website

list_items.text: - Mr J. Whitlow, clerk to the council (in attendance)
(a) 26/0412, extension to the rear of 14 Mill Road: no objection.
(b) 26/0455, change of use of the former dairy, Church Street: objection on parking grounds.
(c) 26/0471, felling of two ash trees at Glebe Field: no objection, subject to replanting.
The committee resolved to submit the comments above to the district council by 19 June.
The committee supported the footpath diversion in principle, on two conditions:
the new route must be surfaced and waymarked;
the old route must remain open until the work is complete.
The next meeting will be held on Tuesday 14 July 2026.
